test_title: PYST 5: SSC CPO - English (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A disease prevalent in a community or a specific region at a specific time, affecting a large area.
solution: The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. **"Epidemic"**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Epidemic** (महामारी) - A widespread disease outbreak in a **community **at a particular time. • **Example**: The flu epidemic affected thousands. • **Epidemic **accurately expresses the given group of words "A disease prevalent in a community or a specific region at a specific time, affecting a large area."(किसी समुदाय या किसी विशिष्ट क्षेत्र में किसी विशिष्ट समय में प्रचलित कोई बीमारी, जो एक बड़े क्षेत्र को प्रभावित करती है।) Therefore, the correct answer is "Epidemic". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __ • **Pandemic **(महामारी) - A disease outbreak affecting large populations **globally**. • **Example**: The COVID-19 pandemic impacted the entire world. • **Eradicate **(उन्मूलन करना) - To completely eliminate something. • **Example**: Efforts continue to eradicate malaria. • **Endemic **(स्थानिक) - A disease constantly present in a specific region. • **Example**: Lyme disease is endemic in parts of the USA. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__** • **Epidemic **(महामारी) - A widespread disease outbreak in a **COMMUNITY **at a particular time • Pandemic (महामारी) - A disease outbreak affecting large populations GLOBALLY. 4d:T7dc, The correct answer is Option 2) i.e. "**Bottom**".
